subject: fix(chat): accept natural Rapi wake phrases

prompts.loose: 라피 호출어 인식이 너무 빡빡해. 자연스럽게 불러도 반응하게 고쳐줘.
prompts.strict: Make the failing test tests/chat-invocation.test.ts pass. Add and export parseRapiInvocation(content: string): string | null in packages/contracts/src/chatops.ts: return null when the message does not start with the wake word '라피' or '라피야' (word must end at end-of-text, whitespace, or punctuation like ! ? , : . ~ including full-width forms); otherwise return the remaining request with leading punctuation/whitespace stripped and trimmed (empty string if nothing follows). Use it in apps/chat/src/orchestrator.ts instead of the hardcoded /^라피야!\s*/ regex: ignore messages where it returns null, and reply '무엇을 도와드릴까요? 질문을 함께 보내주세요.' when it returns an empty string. Do not edit the test file. Done when 'npx tsc -b && npx tsx --test tests/chat-invocation.test.ts' passes.
